raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Native SM107 D128 ragged attention currently waits for THD setup to finish before starting its independent CTA/cluster initialization. Allow that initialization to overlap setup through an internal programmatic dependency, for both packed and unpacked plans.

The setup launch keeps ordinary stream ordering with its input producers and releases its dependent grid early. Every main-kernel role waits after local initialization and before reading metadata, tensor-map descriptors, or other dependent global inputs. Other helper callers retain the default behavior. Public APIs, plan admission, workspace, launch count, and caller-visible PDL handling are unchanged; dense and other head-size bodies remain on their existing path.

Validation:
- 204 native functional cases, including O/Stats, changed lengths, fresh bindings, and poisoned retained CUDA Graph replay. The qualified kernel/helper blobs were carried unchanged onto the landed parent; the final edit only clarifies a comment and preserves the Python AST.
- Four memcheck, four racecheck, and four synccheck workloads passed. The latter two use CPU FP64 reference arithmetic to avoid instrumenting the GPU reference; an earlier reference-side timeout is retained in the validation record.
- A fresh matched old/new run on the landed parent completed 96 full-attention observations across six shapes, CGA1/CGA2, packed/unpacked, and output/Stats modes. All numerical and poisoned-replay checks passed. Performance evidence is retained internally with its measurement limits.
- Existing compiler checks cover THD dependency instructions and unchanged dense/non-SM107 artifacts. Scoped pre-commit hooks pass.

This change is independent of #1850. Their clean composition passed 20 existing packed/unpacked CGA1/CGA2 lifecycle tests and 96 full-attention observations; all O/Stats and poisoned-replay checks passed. The two individual performance effects are not assumed to be additive.

 # +0.3 % on one) and is a no-op on every cga1 rendering by construction (the cluster arm folds out at CGA_SIZE 1; the cubins
 # are byte-identical), so this kernel carries no constant for it.
 SPIN_RING_WAITS: bool = True
+# Overlap THD setup with the main kernel's independent barrier initialization.
+# This internal dependency changes neither admission nor the caller's PDL
+# contract. Dense and other head-size bodies stay unchanged.
+THD_SETUP_PDL: bool = bool(CFG.THD_VARLEN and CFG.TILE_K == 128 and CFG.TILE_O == 128)
 # exp2 MUFU / FMA split -- the Rubin small-D PROBE (an experiment, never a default on cc 10.7).  ``tile_dsl.pointwise.exp2_emul_pair``
 # evaluates a compile-time subset of every row's exp2 on the FMA pipe (6 packed FP32 / INT instructions per pair, no MUFU.EX2): the
 # sm100 d128 kernels' ``_E2E_*`` block (pattern (16, 4, TILE_N): the LAST 4 of every 16 columns; shipped there on cc 10.0 only), which
@@ -190,6 +194,7 @@ def _e2e_pairs(chunk: int, chunk_elems: int = CFG.BMM2_CHUNK_SIZE) -> frozenset:
     advance,
     cga_arrive,
     cga_wait,
+    wait_on_dependent_grids,
     # `wait` (free fn) — still used for sched.mb_* (Sched is not in Bars yet;
     # only the per-kernel Bars NamedTuple was migrated to MBarrier in this step).
     wait,
@@ -1163,6 +1168,13 @@ def _kernel(
         cga_arrive()
         cga_wait()
 
+    if cutlass.const_expr(THD_SETUP_PDL):
+        # Every role waits before its first dependent global read. Everything
+        # above is CTA/cluster-local initialization; the scheduler's lengths,
+        # live-work counter, sinks and TMA descriptor loads are all below.
+        # The setup's early release is only a scheduling hint, not visibility.
+        wait_on_dependent_grids()
+
     # @cute.kernel stages if/else — use Python ternaries so the chosen
     # expression flows into the trace (variables in branches aren't visible outside).
     cta_id_x = cute.arch.block_idx_in_cluster() if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.CTA_MMA == 2) else cutlass.Int32(0)
@@ -5215,6 +5227,7 @@ def _tma_swz(byte_w: int):
             cutlass.Int32(CGA_TILE_M // HEADS_PER_TILE),
             n_thd_units,
             small_batch_meta=True,
+            release_dependents=THD_SETUP_PDL,
         ).launch(grid=(1, 1, 1), block=(THD_SETUP_THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream)
         grid_shape = (n_thd_units * cutlass.Int32(CFG.CGA_M), cutlass.Int32(1), cutlass.Int32(1))
     else:
@@ -5256,6 +5269,7 @@ def _tma_swz(byte_w: int):
         block=[CFG.THREADS_PER_CTA, 1, 1],
         cluster=(CFG.CTA_MMA, 1, CFG.BIAS_MCAST_CTAS),
         stream=stream,
+        use_pdl=THD_SETUP_PDL,
     )

@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@

 from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.swizzle import swizzle_xor
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.barrier import launch_dependent_grids
 
 from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.thd import (
     TENSOR_MAP_QWORDS,
@@ -293,6 +294,7 @@ def build_thd_meta_o_descs_kernel(
     splits: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 1,
     rank_by_kv: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
     small_batch_meta: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+    release_dependents: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
 ) -> None:
     """Per-execute f16/bf16 THD metadata, O descriptors, and scheduler bounds.
 
@@ -316,6 +318,13 @@ def build_thd_meta_o_descs_kernel(
     sequence, so the metadata buffer holds ``THD_WORK_META_WORDS(B)`` words.
     """
     tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    if cutlass.const_expr(release_dependents):
+        # This setup launch retains ordinary stream ordering with its input
+        # producers. Only its consumer opts into PDL: allow that consumer's
+        # independent prologue to start, then require griddepcontrol.wait
+        # before it reads any metadata or runtime tensor-map descriptor.
+        if tidx == 0:
+            launch_dependent_grids()
     nthreads, _, _ = cute.arch.block_dim()
     meta = cutlass.make_array_view(meta_t)
     fused_meta = cutlass.Boolean(False)
